source: engine/bohemia_quadruped.js: pose -> raster, palette-indexed, a one-pixel border, the back lit (45 law), the far legs in shadow

idle.for: waiting on the board: the breath, the tail, an ear flick a bar

step.for: moving one house tile: the four-beat walk, two or three paws always down

run.for: a long move (fast, Battle Brothers' Direwolf): the gallop, a moment in the air

bite.for: the attack: crouch, spring with the jaws open, the bite shut on him, back

fall.for: struck down: the legs go, it lies, the head last

dead.for: lying where it fell (the fall's last picture)

clips_by: frame = cols[floor(progress * cols.length)], progress over beats * 500 ms (the 120 beat); three pictures a beat, the men's grid

scale.note: the same 112 frame and the same ground line as fight_people: a man is ~100 px tall in it, the dire wolf ~62 at the ears and 44 at the shoulder (a real one: 80 cm at the shoulder against a 1.75 m man)

dire_wolf.name: dire wolf
dire_wolf.bb: Direwolf (fast, pack; 12 action points, bites three times if it does not move: library 09, Grok 01/08)
dire_wolf.lore: de-extinct from the Ice Age record (Aenocyon dirus), out of its lab when the dollar died; the yellow ear tag is its lab number

packed: lossless WebP, every pixel checked identical to the bake
